wreck.title: Служба национальных парков США · Трёхмерные копии находок с испанских кораблекрушений
wreck.passage: VCU's Virtual Curation Lab and NPS made 3D scans of Spanish coins found near the La Galga and Juno wrecks. One digital example has a denomination marked on its reverse; another is dated 1741. Some irregularly shaped silver coins were cut from bars and chipped to match a specified weight.

button.title: Служба национальных парков США · Находки из раскопок в Скагуэе
button.passage: A metal military button found in excavations is stamped Waterbury Button Co.

cameo.title: Метрополитен-музей · Стеклянный медальон с портретом Августа
cameo.passage: Roman cameo glass medallion of Augustus. Artwork details describe it as glass cast in two layers.

seal.title: Historic England · Свинцовые пломбы из Уэст-Бакфастли
seal.passage: Portable Antiquities record describes three incomplete lead-alloy kosher food label seals, circa 1750–1900.
